''See also: [[Rebekkah Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Rebekkah is a character characterized by her long red hair, which she wears in a single braid. Her attire consists of simple brown clothing and a rope belt, resembling the garments worn by impoverished villagers or [[Simon]] prior to his arrival at [[the House]]. She possesses a combative and spirited personality, often encouraging others to engage in physical confrontations or to use force to obtain information. She expresses an interest in the figure [[Alin]] through [[Simon]]'s accounts and holds opinions regarding Azura's preference for individuals who are willing to initiate conflict. Throughout various situations, she provides vocal support, warnings, and commentary to her companions.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Rebekkah is a doll whose left arm has been half torn off at the shoulder. This injury is currently managed with her arm being bound in a sling.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|She communicates with [[Simon]], at one point urging him to regain his killer instinct. She also engages in laughter and has shared information with [[Gloria]] regarding [[Simon]]'s actions.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Rebekkah is a doll who maintains communication with [[Simon]], having previously spoken with [[Gloria]] about his journey into [[Endross]]. During their interactions, she laughed and urged [[Simon]] to reclaim his killer instinct. She eventually began communicating with him through mental means while located in the [[graveyard]]. Following an incident where her left arm was half torn off at the shoulder, her limb was eventually bound in a sling.}}
